card.name: Scattered spots in dosing and monitoring text
card.fires_on: No single word or setting; it fires on a number-range gap, 'Monitor' starting a sentence, 'as' or 'to' after 'response', and partway through 'cholecystitis' and 'Lymphography'.

modes.label: Monitor after interaction cite
modes.description: The word Monitor opens a sentence right after a Drug Interactions reference.

modes.label: Gap inside number ranges
modes.description: The space before the second number in a dose or pressure range.

modes.label: Partway through medical words
modes.description: Middle pieces of long medical terms.

card.plain: It fires on unrelated spots, such as the start of a 'Monitor blood pressure' sentence or a space inside a dose range, with no single theme.
